name: Tempest
description: The Tempest was Mika the Hutt's customized battlecruiser and served as the base for his attempts to process the spice of the same name. Mika embezzled funds from various Anjiliac clan holdings to finance the ship's construction in secret. Its hull and keel were constructed years previously to house the processing machinery, but Mika was unable to complete the ship until the trade in Tempest expanded, shortly before the death of Mika's sire, Popara the Hutt.
